artifacts.notes: Whole 465-page provider PDF, 101,944,759 bytes, below 100 MiB. Bonn catalogues [14], 392, 48 printed pages. Auxiliary service book, not a complete celebrant missal.
artifacts.rights_basis: The original title prints 1905; the Bonn catalogue year 1912 is contradicted by the scanned title and spine. The 1905 book is public domain in the United States by expired publication term. Bonn ULB marks the exact digitization (https://digitale-sammlungen.ulb.uni-bonn.de/content/titleinfo/3724368) Public Domain Mark 1.0. Retain the unchanged 465-page PDF, 101,944,759 bytes, below 100 MiB, with Bonn attribution. Keep this auxiliary deacon/server book distinct from a complete celebrant missal and from the registered 1881 Mosul diaconicon until textual identity is established.
